name: 66007 · Basehor, KS
findings: ZIP 66007 (Basehor) has 31 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (70% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66007 (Basehor) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 66007 (Basehor) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
